summary: Added a show_speed parameter (default False) to TaskProgressColumn in rich/progress.py. When the task total is unknown and show_speed is true, the column renders the speed as "<speed>.1f it/s" using task.finished_speed or task.speed, and renders empty text if no speed is available yet. Known-total and show_speed=False behavior is unchanged. Tests were not run and nothing was committed, per the instructions.
